title: PowerPoint for Mac: Copilot edits presentations through chat for Copilot Chat users
notes: claim 63: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says the two Mac roadmap records have no difference beyond their targets, although one explicitly requires a Copilot licence and adds brand-kit capabilities. The Cloud Policy route mixes selecting an existing configuration with the creation wizard, and the assertion that Copilot can edit any open presentation overlooks the documented label restriction.
